rationale: CONV-CS-2 (#751): csharp had NO framework detection at all — metadata.detectedFrameworks was undefined while python emits [] (empty payload shell) and java a string; the metadata key itself was not family-uniform. The mechanism mirrors the java sibling (using-root prefixes + base types + attribute names feeding a fixed-priority list; the array is emitted in detection-priority order so import order can never change it). This fixture carries three simultaneous marker families and the exact detectedFrameworks/frameworkPatterns payload is pinned (expectMetadata), while forbidFrameworks guards the five families whose markers are absent — a substring over-match or a fabricated framework fails. The framework-none fixture pins the empty shell ([] not undefined).
